basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Qatar University (QU Main Campus, Doha, Qatar)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all university colleges: College of Engineering (Computer Science, AI, Mechanical, Civil, Chemical, Electrical), College of Medicine, College of Pharmacy, College of Health Sciences, College of Arts and Sciences, College of Business and Economics, College of Law, and College of Education.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~400 to 500 competitive international scholarships awarded annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open global competition; Pakistan has a large admitted student body (typically 20 to 35 Pakistani awardees/yr across undergrad and postgrad)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Full standard study period: 4 years for Bachelor's; 2 years for Master's; 3 to 4 years for PhD

nationality_requirements: International students of non-Qatari citizenship residing outside Qatar
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Undergraduate applicants must have graduated high school within the past 2-3 years.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: High school graduation certificate with minimum 95% average for undergraduate; Bachelor's degree (16 years) with minimum 3.00 CGPA for Master's; Master's degree (18 years) with minimum 3.00 CGPA for PhD.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Undergraduate entrance requires minimum 90-95% high school marks (or A grades in A-Levels); graduate entry requires minimum 3.00 / 4.00 CGPA (3.50+ competitive).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Advanced mathematics, chemistry, and biology for health/medicine colleges; advanced mathematics and physics for engineering colleges.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or currently in final semester of degree graduating before semester start.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: Undergraduate certificates must not be older than 3 years.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Research publications and thesis experience prioritized for doctoral applicants.

english_proficiency.notes: TOEFL iBT min 68 or IELTS Academic min 6.0 for engineering/science/business; Medicine/Pharmacy requires IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 80.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: English (or Arabic for Arabic-track Islamic Studies/Law/Humanities programs).
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: None (co-educational university with separate male and female campus wings).
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Must not be holding another scholarship concurrently.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver for all credit hours and course modules for normative degree duration.

admission_application_fee.details: Online application fee of QAR 200 (~USD $55 / ~PKR 15,000) paid online on QU portal.

accommodation.details: Free on-campus university student housing (separate modern male and female residential halls) with complimentary utilities and Wi-Fi.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living allowance of QAR 500/month (~PKR 38,000/month) for undergraduate scholarship holders; graduate research assistants receive QAR 3,000 to 6,000/month (~PKR 228,000 to 456,000/month).

airfare.details: Annual round-trip economy airfare ticket provided between Doha and Islamabad/Karachi/Lahore.

visa_fee.details: Qatar student residency permit and visa issuance covered and sponsored directly by Qatar University.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive health care at Qatar University Medical Clinic and Hamad Medical Corporation public hospitals covered under Qatari public health system.

food_allowance.details: Free 3 meals per day provided in university student dining halls for resident scholarship students.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Free course textbooks provided directly by the university textbook section.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Qatar National Research Fund (QNRF) and QU internal grants provide conference travel and research funding.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free university shuttle bus transportation between student housing and academic colleges; free airport pickup.

university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: #122 QS World University Rankings 2025; Top 2 in the Arab World; AACSB and ABET accredited.
available_majors: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Medicine (MD), Pharmacy, Biomedical Sciences, Public Health, Business, Economics, Law
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: High school certificate (90%+ average) for undergraduate; Bachelor's/Master's degree (3.00+ CGPA) for graduate with English and standardized tests.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: College of Medicine and College of Pharmacy are extremely competitive (require 95%+ marks); engineering and computer science have larger cohorts.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Apply for university admission during the international applicant window and submit the online scholarship application simultaneously.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Qatar University Online Admission & Scholarship System (Banner Self-Service)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the Qatar University online application portal, select international admission, and complete the scholarship application.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Check international application dates on QU website (typically opens October-November for Fall intake).
2. Create account on QU Banner admission portal.
3. Fill out application form, select target college and degree program.
4. Tick the checkbox to apply for Qatar University International Scholarship.
5. Upload academic transcripts, high school/degree certificates, passport copy, and personal photo.
6. Upload standardized test scores (IELTS/TOEFL and SAT Math if applying for engineering/science).
7. Pay application fee (QAR 200) online via credit card.
8. Central scholarship committee reviews applicants and publishes merit lists in May.
9. Selected students receive official scholarship award and admission letters.
10. QU International Students Section processes entry visa and sends electronic flight ticket.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated concurrent application: scholarship application submitted within the main admission portal.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Required for graduate applicants; uploaded directly or emailed by referees.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Personal statement explaining academic ambitions, choice of Qatar University, and future career plans.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Required for PhD applicants: research proposal outlining proposed doctoral thesis topic.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing secondary/post-secondary education, academic awards, and extracurriculars.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online video interviews conducted for College of Medicine and graduate doctoral applicants.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS/TOEFL required for English-track programs; SAT Math (min 530+) required for engineering foundation exemption.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Educational certificates and transcripts attested by Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) Pakistan and Embassy of Qatar in Islamabad.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% online through Qatar University Banner portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned copy of valid international passport data page
High school or university transcripts and certificates showing high GPA
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by IBCC / HEC, MOFA Pakistan, and Qatar Embassy in Islamabad
Official test report sent to Qatar University code 0244

required_documents_checklist.specification: Detailed academic CV and statement of academic intent
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Detail academic achievements and science competitions

required_documents_checklist.specification: General medical fitness examination from recognized hospital

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Main intake for international scholarship students is Fall semester (opens October, closes mid-February).

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 60% (High school percentage or university GPA, STEM subject marks)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 15% (For graduate applicants: publications and thesis quality)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Quality of personal statement and career vision)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Qatar University Scholarship Committee and College Deans.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Document screening and grade ranking -> Departmental committee evaluation -> University Scholarship Committee final approval.

competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 95.0%+ high school marks (or 3.70+ / 4.00 CGPA for graduate)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Top provincial high school position holders, A* grade students in A-Levels, and first-class university graduates with excellent standardized test scores.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Strong Pakistani representation across College of Engineering, Medicine, and Pharmacy at Qatar University.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Egypt, Jordan, Syria, Palestine, Pakistan, India, Sudan, Yemen.

fake_websites_and_scams: Fraudulent domains claiming direct Qatar University admissions: qu-scholarships-doha.org, qatar-studentvisas.com.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application fee of QAR 200 is paid strictly through Qatar University official portal. No extra fee is charged for scholarship evaluation.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Qatar University does not partner with commercial study-abroad agents.
itemized_hidden_out_of_pocket_costs: Qatar Embassy document attestation fees (~PKR 35,000 to 55,000)
Medical examination fee from Qatar Visa Center (QVC) upon visa processing (~PKR 25,000)
debunked_myths_and_misconceptions: MYTH: Meals and accommodation are charged. (Truth: International scholarship students receive free on-campus dorms and 3 free meals a day in student cafeterias).
MYTH: You need Arabic to study engineering or medicine. (Truth: All STEM, engineering, medical, and pharmacy degrees at QU are taught 100% in English).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Agents claim all students get QAR 3,000/month; undergraduate stipend is QAR 500/month, but full room, board, tuition, and flights are 100% covered.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.50 out of 4.00 for undergraduate and 3.00 out of 4.00 for graduate students.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical attendance; registering for at least 12 credit hours per semester (undergrad) or 9 credit hours (grad).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester GPA evaluations; warning issued if GPA drops below threshold.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: On-campus student employment permitted up to 20 hours per week (paid ~QAR 35 to 45/hour); off-campus work restricted.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; graduates have access to Qatar's professional employment market under work sponsorship.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is cancelled if GPA drops below threshold for two consecutive semesters or if student withdraws.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing colleges requires prior approval from Scholarship Committee.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Strictly limited to the standard degree duration.
